title: UBC 2022 Final: MOCHY vs SANDER (Match 11) Backgammon
description: Backgammongalaxy.com and FMGammon.com presents: The Ultimate Backgammon Championship 2022 Final: Super-Grandmaster Masayuki "Mochy" Mochizuki (Champion, Japan) vs Grandmaster Sander Lylloff (Challenger, Denmark).  SPONSORS:  https://www.backgammongalaxy.com https://www.fmgammon.com  LOCATION:  Tunnel Tokyo, Tokyo, Japan  FORMAT:  The final is decided via twelve 7-point matches, where the players get 1 point for a win and 1 point for a "PR Win" (the player with the lowest error rate according to eXtreme Gammon XG++ analysis). The first player to achieve 13 points wins the championship title.  –––  GALAXY APP:  Browser play: https://play.backgammongalaxy.com App Store: https://apple.co/3ju5EwY Google Play: https://bit.ly/3hT89rX  INSTAGRAM:  @backgammongalaxy: https://bit.ly/3xpx8q7 @marcolsen10: https://bit.ly/3p4RX6u @nickblasier: https://bit.ly/3YJfeMo  FACEBOOK:  Mochy (Facebook): https://bit.ly/3riumSD Sander Lylloff (Facebook): https://bit.ly/3GbhaGj  Backgammon Galaxy: https://bit.ly/3FRNvyH Backgammon Strategy: https://bit.ly/3CTqklX Backgammon Memes: https://bit.ly/3cUniTG Backgammon News: https://bit.ly/3HUy3E8  BOOKS:  From Basics to Badass: https://amzn.to/3DVxQOw Pure Strategy: https://amzn.to/313N59i Cube Like a Boss: https://amzn.to/3xozHc4  BOARDS:  Marc's favorite combo: https://bit.ly/3jr83bo Monte Carlo Board: https://bit.ly/3YLOHOE PRIMAL Board: https://bit.ly/3YHrJYX Adventure Board: https://bit.ly/3v9SCHt  BOOKING:  BGWC 2023:  UBC 2023 Contender + Istavder Annual:
